user.title: Inky Frame
user.description: Where does the frame service answer? Home Assistant and the frame usually run on the same Pi, so the defaults are normally right.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the frame service at that address.
error.not_a_frame: That address answered, but it is not an Inky Frame service (no device id in /status).

abort.already_configured: This frame is already set up.

init.title: Inky Frame panel
init.description: Address a BROWSER can reach the frame's gallery on. Use the https:// address when Home Assistant is served over HTTPS, or the browser will block the panel as mixed content. Leave empty to hide the panel's contents.
